Context: Seventh Pay Commission Recommendations.-

## Seventh Pay Commission Recommendations.-  
Seventh Pay Commission recommends to consider the following in granting Special Casual Leave as under.-  
1. Review the purposes for which SCL is presently granted.
2. Limit the number of purposes for which an employee can be granted SCL in a year.
3. Limit the total number of days that an employee can be granted SCL in a year. - Para. 9.2.33 of VII CPC Report.
